row.title: Deploy version probe skips failed uploads
row.body: ZHC-R6 closes on deploydrift --versions: every uploaded deploy row must carry a version id and a live read that matched the commit. A failed upload has no version, so it is not counted. Since 2026-11-26 it passes on all 540 uploaded rows; the 40 seed rows without a version all failed a migration and never uploaded.

title: Deploy version probe skips failed uploads
